title: A Counter channel produces a gap-free ascending sequence from Min
intent: The foundation every other deterministic case rests on. Counter.next() returns the current value and then advances, and SimulatorSource calls it once per channel per read, so the emitted sequence is a function of read count alone - not of wall-clock time. If this case is not exact, no count-gated assertion elsewhere can be trusted. It also proves the whole harness path end to end: config placeholder substitution, the file sink as a record counter, and SFC's own metrics reaching the JSONL writer.

assert.comment: Valid here because the file sink preserves pipeline order. Over a queue this would be channelValueRun instead.
The fingerprint of a dependency version split. These leave the process exiting 0, so nothing else would notice.
